technology_name: A RAIL SLEEPER ANCHORAGE SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR ENHANCING STABILITY AND STIFFNESS OF RAIL SLEEPERS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Temperature-induced track expansion and poor fastening retention cause standard rail lines to shift laterally, triggering premature track alignment maintenance loops.
description: An integrated railway sleeper anchoring system designed to attach securely to transit ties, utilizing a combination of steel-plated grooved sections ($SPGS$) anchors to maximize soil lateral shear resistance and lock line geometries securely under severe wheel forces.
applications: Mainline commuter rail paths, extreme-temperature desert railway systems, sharp-radius mountain transit loops, and heavy freight terminal track lines.
